item: Report the SDK fixer bugs to dotnet/roslyn
notes: Minimal repros for the SDK fixers in multi-targeted projects under `dotnet format`, all posted (2026-10-11): https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn/issues/86000 (Fix All writes conflict markers), https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn/issues/86001 ("Changes must be within bounds of SourceText" crash), https://github.com/dotnet/sdk/issues/56585 (whitespace pass formats only the first target framework's `#if` code), https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn/issues/86002 (IDE0065's fix changes binding: CS0104/CS0118). Follow-up: "Offer PRs for the reported SDK bugs".
